scope: Private behavior-preserving scalar-grouping module extraction. User requests focused Rust modules and automatic CPU profiling. No arithmetic, grouping policy, memory admission, query geometry, runtime option or solver format changes.

validation.oracle: Independent scalar-weighted generator sums and ordered-value class metadata; panic completion and pool reuse.

performance.interpretation: A structural refactor may pass a declared nonregression tolerance without a speedup claim. All timings retained; no unchanged reroll or post-run gate change.

memory.inherited_analysis: Original grouping allocation capacities and reservations remain; function bodies, field types and field order are audited. Existing accepted large-circuit qualification remains provenance, not a newly measured candidate result.
